sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- Govt. Advocate
Hon'ble Sudhir Agarwal,J.
1.
None appeared to press this revision.
In the circumstances, I myself have perused the record.

2. This criminal revision under Section 397/401 Cr.P.C., has been filed aggrieved by judgement and order dated 17.09.1998 passed by IVth Additional District and Sessions Judge, Muzaffarnagar in Criminal Appeal No. 110 of 1997, dismissing appeal and confirming sentence and conviction imposed by learned Special Judicial Magistrate/ Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate Ist,
Muzaffarnagar vide judgement and order dated 11.11.1997 in Criminal Case No. 2435/9 of 1994,
under Sections 7/16A of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act.

entities.text: IVth Additional District and Sessions Judge, Muzaffarnagar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Being aggrieved, revisionist preferred present revision.

3. Having gone through the record, I do not find any manifest error or otherwise illegality,
procedural or otherwise, so as to justify interference in criminal revision.
